verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Universal SSL docs state that it issues and renews free, unshared, publicly trusted SSL certificates for every domain added to and activated on Cloudflare. That covers the free, automatically renewing, every-domain core of the story for Workers running on Cloudflare's network. Missing for 10: any evidence of wildcard certificate coverage, details on how certificates apply to Workers custom domains and routes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
